title: Recording header
description: The JSON header of a recording (section 7.4). The file is: 4 bytes 'RWRC', u32 header length, the UTF-8 JSON header, padding to 4 bytes, then one fixed-size binary record per generated token. Each record: u32 id, u32 piece index into header.pieces, 20 x (u32 id, f16 prob, f16 pad), 477 x f16 pushes (push_order in conventions), padding to 4 bytes, 28 x 5 x (u32 id, f16 prob, f16 pad) floor guesses, f16 cut index, f16 temperature.
